## 操作任务
实现compare(request,index)。POST index/_analyze(field=message,text=Quick Brown)取得tokens；分别实际搜索raw_term=term message原文Quick Brown、normalized_term=term message小写quick、keyword_exact=term message.raw原文、phrase=match_phrase message原文；各size100，非200 RuntimeError。返回{tokens:原token列表,四查询名:排序命中ID}。不改原文、mapping或通配符补救。平台同原文五样本区分分词、大小写、精确词项与顺序。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7标准分析器、text/keyword多字段、term/match_phrase五样本对照。与同义词规则重开、BM25统计、JSON exists不同；不宣称全库相关性优化或任意语言分词覆盖。

提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status in (200,201),(method,path,status,value)
 return value
def docs(server,index):return {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000')['hits']['hits']}
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 index='term_analysis';call(server,'PUT','/'+index,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0},'mappings':{'properties':{'message':{'type':'text','analyzer':'standard','fields':{'raw':{'type':'keyword'}}}}}})
 bodies={'upper':{'message':'Quick Brown'},'lower':{'message':'quick brown'},'one-token':{'message':'quick fox'},'reversed':{'message':'brown quick'},'other':{'message':'slow fox'}}
 for docid,body in bodies.items():call(server,'PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?refresh=true',body)
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_STANDARD_TEXT_TOKENS_AND_EXACT_KEYWORD_SAME_SOURCE_DIFFER',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_analyze_raw_term_normalized_term_keyword_phrase_comparison',flush=True)
 try:result=task.compare(server.request,index)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual term analysis failed') from error
 assert result=={'tokens':['quick','brown'],'raw_term':[],'normalized_term':['lower','one-token','reversed','upper'],'keyword_exact':['upper'],'phrase':['lower','upper']},'term/match/keyword/phrase semantics conflated'
 assert docs(server,index)==bodies
 print('NATIVE_TERM_DOES_NOT_ANALYZE_SOURCE_PHRASE_ORDER_EXACT_CASE_AND_SINGLE_TOKEN_SEPARATE',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

## 操作任务
实现day(request,index,date,zone)。按ISO日历date算下一日，POST index/_search size100，range at={gte:当日T00:00:00,lt:下一日T00:00:00,time_zone:传入IANA zone}；非200/timed_out/failed RuntimeError，返回排序ID。不能固定UTC午夜、固定24小时或包含下一日午夜，不改索引存储时间。原生America/New_York春季23小时/秋季25小时两日，各有前1ms、起点、中点、末1ms、下一起点UTC样本。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7 date range服务端IANA时区转换，固定2024年美国两次DST和半开边界。与096覆盖事件时间恢复不同；不重写UTC原值，也不声称所有时区历史规则或生产看板设置已审。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status in (200,201),(method,path,status,value)
 return value
def docs(server,index):return {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000')['hits']['hits']}
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 index='date_boundaries';call(server,'PUT','/'+index,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0},'mappings':{'properties':{'at':{'type':'date'}}}})
 cases=[('2024-03-10','2024-03-10T05:00:00+00:00','2024-03-11T04:00:00+00:00',23),('2024-11-03','2024-11-03T04:00:00+00:00','2024-11-04T05:00:00+00:00',25)]
 bodies={};expected={}
 for day,start,end,hours in cases:
  left=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(start);right=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(end);assert (right-left).total_seconds()==hours*3600
  samples={'before':left-datetime.timedelta(milliseconds=1),'start':left,'middle':left+datetime.timedelta(hours=12),'last':right-datetime.timedelta(milliseconds=1),'end':right}
  for suffix,instant in samples.items():
   docid=day+'-'+suffix;body={'at':instant.isoformat()};bodies[docid]=body;call(server,'PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?refresh=true',body)
  expected[day]=sorted(day+'-'+suffix for suffix in ('start','middle','last'))
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_UTC_INSTANTS_NEW_YORK_SPRING23_HOURS_FALL25_HOURS_BOUNDARIES',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:local_calendar_midnight_half_open_range_iana_zone_no_storage_rewrite',flush=True)
 for date,start,end,hours in cases:
  try:result=task.day(server.request,index,date,'America/New_York')
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual zoned day query failed') from error
  assert result==expected[date],'UTC midnight, fixed24-hour day or inclusive next midnight changed day membership'
 assert docs(server,index)==bodies
 print('NATIVE_DATE_RANGE_BOTH_DST_TRANSITIONS_HALF_OPEN_MIDNIGHTS_UTC_SOURCE_UNCHANGED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

body:
## 操作任务
实现restore(request,index,approved_ids)：仅PUT index/_mapping设置tag keyword ignore_above=8；逐个GET批准ID，以原_source、原ID、if_seq_no/if_primary_term和refresh=true PUT回索引，非成功RuntimeError。不改输入/其他文档。实际原限额4时abcd可检索聚合而abcde仅_source存在；新限额8加批准重索引后旧长值可查可聚合，保护短值/超长值的_source和_seq_no保持，新6字符值可索引，9字符仍不建立tag值。仅改mapping不视为旧数据恢复。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7 keyword ignore_above ASCII长度边界、mapping允许更新与实际批准文档重索引。020未使用此机制，shared exists/_source辅助不再计数；不外推Unicode UTF16长度、大规模生产回填或缺失原文恢复。

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status in (200,201),(method,path,status,value)
 return value
def docs(server,index):return {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000')['hits']['hits']}
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 index='keyword_length';call(server,'PUT','/'+index,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':1,'number_of_replicas':0},'mappings':{'properties':{'tag':{'type':'keyword','ignore_above':4}}}})
 bodies={'boundary':{'tag':'abcd','message':'keep-short'},'long':{'tag':'abcde','message':'approved-history'},'outside':{'tag':'abcdefghi','message':'outside-limit'}}
 for docid,body in bodies.items():call(server,'PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?refresh=true',body)
 def buckets():return {row['key']:row['doc_count'] for row in call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search',{'size':0,'aggs':{'tags':{'terms':{'field':'tag','size':100}}}})['aggregations']['tags']['buckets']}
 def search(value):return call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search',{'query':{'term':{'tag':value}}})['hits']['hits']
 assert buckets()=={'abcd':1} and search('abcde')==[] and call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_doc/long')['_source']['tag']=='abcde'
 protected={key:call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+key) for key in ('boundary','outside')};approved=['long'];before=copy.deepcopy(approved)
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_KEYWORD_IGNORE_ABOVE4_SOURCE_LONG_RETAINED_BUT_TERM_AND_AGG_ABSENT',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:approved_limit8_and_actual_version_guarded_history_reindex_not_mapping_only',flush=True)
 calls=[]
 def request(method,path,body=None,**kwargs):calls.append((method,path));return server.request(method,path,body,**kwargs)
 try:task.restore(request,index,approved)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual keyword indexing recovery failed') from error
 assert call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_mapping')[index]['mappings']['properties']['tag']['ignore_above']==8
 assert buckets()=={'abcd':1,'abcde':1} and {row['_id'] for row in search('abcde')}=={'long'},'mapping change alone did not index old long value'
 assert docs(server,index)==bodies and all(call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+key)==value for key,value in protected.items())
 assert any(method=='PUT' and '/_doc/long?' in path and 'if_seq_no=' in path and 'if_primary_term=' in path for method,path in calls)
 call(server,'PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/future?refresh=true',{'tag':'abcdef','message':'new-long-allowed'})
 assert buckets()=={'abcd':1,'abcde':1,'abcdef':1} and search('abcdefghi')==[] and approved==before
 print('NATIVE_IGNORE_ABOVE_APPROVED_HISTORY_TERM_AGG_RESTORED_NEW_LONG_ALLOWED_OVER_LIMIT_AND_OTHER_VERSIONS_RETAINED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
